# opstracer_org_invitation (Resource)

An invitation for someone to join the org. Once the invitee accepts, the invitation stays in state with `status = "accepted"` and destroying it only drops it from state; manage the new member with `opstracer_org_member`. A revoked or expired invitation is removed from state and planned for re-creation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opstracer_org_invitation" "alice" {
  email    = "alice@example.com"
  role     = "MEMBER"
  team_ids = [opstracer_team.backend.id]
}

# Share the join link yourself instead of emailing it.
resource "opstracer_org_invitation" "contractor" {
  email      = "contractor@example.com"
  role       = "MEMBER"
  send_email = false
}

output "contractor_invite_url" {
  value     = opstracer_org_invitation.contractor.invite_url
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address to invite. Compared case-insensitively.
- `role` (String) Org role the invitee gets: `ADMIN` or `MEMBER`. Can be changed while the invitation is pending.

### Optional

- `resend_trigger` (String) Any value. Changing it from one value to another resends the invitation, which also issues a new `invite_url`.
- `send_email` (Boolean) Email the invitation on create and on resend. Set `false` to share `invite_url` yourself.
- `team_ids` (Set of String) Teams the invitee joins on accepting. Can be changed while the invitation is pending.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Invitation ID.
- `invite_url` (String, Sensitive) Join link. Only returned when the invitation is created or resent, so it is empty after import. Changing `role`, `team_ids` or `resend_trigger` issues a new link.
- `status` (String) `pending`, or `accepted` once the invitee has joined.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Only pending invitations can be imported. invite_url stays empty until the link is reissued, and the
# first apply after import records send_email and resend_trigger without calling the API.
terraform import opstracer_org_invitation.alice <invitation-id>
```
